MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNTA2NzQ4.chinese: 那边的那个男孩是我的小弟弟。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNTA2NzQ4.english: Tidy up all your toys are here and there.

I enjoy listening to the sound of rain.
The mother deer is feeding her baby.
The students are going to an art museum tomorrow.
MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNTA2NzQ4.chinese: 学生们明天要去美术馆。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNTA2NzQ4.english: Miss Wang is telling them about some paintings.

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNTA2NzQ4.english: Look at the two pictures on the blackboard.
I like the one on the left.
I like the one on the right.

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNTA2NzQ4.chinese: 一只小狮子非常喜欢画画。

MzI2MTIxOTUxMl8yNjUwNTA2NzQ4.chinese: 他所有的朋友都喜欢他的画。
